claim: Memory continuity is a write-time and placement contract, not a retrieval score. claim: In a prefix-cached agent loop, cost is a function of WHERE context mutates, not how big it is: every token is paid at least once as a write (premium constants 1.25x write / 0.1x read, pre-banked estate knowledge), reads are the discount, and an edit at position i re-prices everything after i (Theo's arithmetic: history 1,2,3,4,5,6, delete 2, and you must rewrite 3,4,5,6 - more expensive than leaving 2 in). Practitioner baseline: cache write costs go over 60 percent of total LLM spend in Claude Code and Codex use. claim: Compression for the local tier has two independent axes and one instrument law that scores both. AXIS 1, WEIGHTS (r/LocalLLM 1wlmg18): within the standard K-quant ladder, bit-width is a TIE, proven with the right instrument - a paired permutation test on the seven page differences, not eyeballed means: Q4_K_M (16.6GB, 13.7 of 17 checks) and Q3_K_M (13.3GB, 13.0) unresolved from bf16 (53.8GB, 13.9), and the OP's 12GB quant Opti (11.4; weights open at huggingface.co/kacaforyah/Opti-27B) unresolved from all three Qwen files (p = 0.13 / 0.34 / 0.38) at 72 percent of Q4_K_M bytes. The cliff claim in its honest, confounded form: BOTH measured sub-12GB points are Ternary Bonsai 2 files loadable only in the PrismML fork, so the cliff conflates size with format and runtime; what that resolved tier shows is WHERE ternary damage lands - the vision path reads the card correctly and the emitted code dies (8 of its 14 pages on JavaScript errors) - the weight-space twin of the estate's tool-call shape laws. The same table separates the base-model failure class no rung fixes (direction-from-diagram 0-2 of 8/12 at EVERY width including bf16) and is the estate's first EXTERNAL falsification of a vendor quant-retention claim (Bonsai 2's 98.2 percent benchmark retention reads 5.9/17 on a real graded build task, OP caveat carried verbatim). AXIS 2, CONTEXT (r/LocalLLM 1wekmhf): compaction is a PLACEMENT problem before it is a cadence or content problem - inter-request compaction never sees intra-request growth (tool results inside one agentic turn), so the loop runs uncompacted to server rejection (132,705 vs 130,048 tokens); the working fix hooks every loop iteration, auto-detects the window, counts via /tokenize (chars_per_token 3.0 only as fallback), distills against an explicit 4-item preserve contract (decisions+rationale, paths/config/code, problems+fixes, pending work), truncates as fallback, and re-summarizes when the summary itself grows. INSTRUMENT LAW: deterministic graded checks, mutant-validated before use (reference 17/17, blank 4/17); the UNIT is the correlated block, not the check; resolution is the disclosed same-config seed spread (bf16 16/17 vs 10/17 on two seeds); unresolved deltas reported as permutation ties - the census denominator law extended from counts to capability scores.

claim: The estate's quantized_thought compiler (tools/thought_quantizer.py) has SHAPE gates and a STALENESS gate but NO decision gate and NO pricing model; find 1 supplies the gate, find 2 the price, and the estate's own bytes already show the failure mode find 1 exists to catch (13 of 338 local-tier rows lose a path/URL/number literal to the 10-word truncation - measured this sitting). FIND 1, THE GATE (PAIR, arXiv 2609.36526): trajectory-level full-vs-compressed comparisons are confounded by agent stochasticity, so PAIR runs matched counterfactual continuations from the same agent state - one with the compression applied, one without - isolating each compression event's causal effect on outcome hazard and interaction burden; headline law: compression degrades reliability before solvability (AppWorld Pass3 79.8-80.4 vs 78.6 uncompressed at about half peak context; the compressed agent exceeds the baseline on reliability); the revision lessons are literally compile gates: preserve exact literals and goal constraints, reconcile summaries against the newest evidence, never promote unsupported answers. FIND 2, THE PRICE (arXiv 2609.22114, out of window 19d, mark carried): from a production gateway - tool-schema filtering is the only unambiguously positive lever (fixed 21K-57K tokens per turn, linear in N); content compression saves ~2 percent of the cache-priced prefix per turn but cumulative savings grow quadratically (3,350*N^2 measured, overtaking the fixed tool-filter saving within roughly 6 turns) only when compressed reads persist; recall re-sends exactly the compressed-away bytes, spending the accumulated saving back one segment at a time; and the authors' own 86.5-percent-retention-at-25.7-percent-compression single-shot result must not be cited as a multi-turn cost-saving argument. SYNTHESIS: compile, then verify the compile the PAIR way (paired renders of the same law, reliability scored across reruns, never one-shot) and price it the gateway way (recall-free by construction or the savings are theater); both instruments janitor-grade - deterministic exact-match scoring, no LLM judge, $0.

claim: Two mechanisms. (1) MODEL AFFINITY: provider prompt caches are per-model namespaces - input a model already saw costs roughly 90 percent less, but the cache is specific to the model - so a router chasing per-call price (easy call to a 15x cheaper model) switches models mid-task, throws away the accumulated warm cache, and re-bills the full accumulated context at cold rates; the bill stays the same. Cost inversion: a cache-hot expensive model can cost less than a cache-cold cheap model. Production shape: route ONCE PER TASK, pin the chosen model to the session, reset the pin at task change; the router itself must be tiny (a routing decision that costs as much as the call it routes saves nothing). The cross-model complement of the within-model byte-identity law; the estate's prior-art router pack (memory/research_packs/20260827_fanout_router_state_of_art.md) holds cascade economics but never prices the switch itself. (2) WIDTH ATTRIBUTION, confirmation-grade: vendor-official wording (ClaudeDevs) that excessive parallel subagent spawning burned usage faster than expected and that rate limits were RESET after the spawn fix - the drain is a rolling-window burst effect, not permanent consumption; upgrades the estate width law's first-contact-is-HOLD ruling to vendor-confirmed disease class.
